description.zh: 云盾证书 ID，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The ID of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.

description.zh:
云盾证书地域，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数。
- 中国站账号传参数值：cn-hangzhou。
- 国际站账号传参数值：ap-southeast-1。
description.en:
The region of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas. Valid values:
- Chinese mainland accounts: cn-hangzhou.
- International accounts: ap-southeast-1.

description.zh:
证书类型，SslFlag 为 on 时需要输入该参数。
- **free**: 免费证书。
- **upload**: 上传证书。
- **cas**: 云盾证书。
description.en:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on. Valid values:
- **free**: free certificate.
- **upload**: uploaded certificate.
- **cas**: SSL Certificates Service certificate.

description.zh: 证书内容，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The certificate content. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

description.zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用[ListCustomHostnames](~~3018667~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the SaaS domain name. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCustomHostnames](~~3018667~~) operation.

description.zh: 证书私钥，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

description.zh: 待绑定记录的ID，可以通过[ListRecords](~~2850265~~)获取。
description.en: The ID of the record to bind. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListRecords](~~2850265~~) operation.

description.zh:
SSL开关。
- **on**: 开启 SSL。
- **off**: 关闭 SSL。
description.en:
The SSL switch. Valid values:
- **on**: Enables SSL.
- **off**: Disables SSL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-custom-hostname --hostname-id 1234567890123 --record-id 1234567890123 --ssl-flag on --cert-type cas --certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE----- --biz-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY----- --cas-id 30000478 --cas-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateCustomHostname --region cn-hangzhou --HostnameId 1234567890123 --PrivateKey '-----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --CertType cas --RecordId 1234567890123 --SslFlag on --CasId 30000478 --CasRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --Certificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----'
